title: Evaluation of a disjunction gate
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, let $i$ be one of its gates, and let $a,b<i$ be earlier gate indices. If gate $i$ is the disjunction of gates $a$ and $b$, then for every input $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, its value is the disjunction of the values at those two earlier gates.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit on n input bits
A gate index i in the circuit
Gate i is the disjunction of gates a and b
